statement: The complete wild intrinsic class-two obstruction on all eight toric relative directions, with actual framed-cusp cocycles, exact marking transport, all fifteen finite coordinates, every conjugacy fibre, and the entire 16713-residue relative image.

notes: The actual z_A0 torsion ambiguity is resolved up to the explicitly retained original phase t; the exact scalar Tate/free-group automorphism P_(1+3t)=I+t j*pi, its inverse, full action/quotient transport and eta_new=eta_old+t are proved. No value is assigned to the old marking. Both actual line-unit equations, the same boundary at tau/tauprime, actual CM/frame correction and all64 vector-frame addition identities determine every cusp Kummer cochain. Complete b_d,r_d,s_d matrices are displayed in the proof and saved in the certificate. The actual source relation gives omega=7 sum a_d[U-k_d,e_d]. Its free degree-two obstruction coordinate is zero; all11 modulo3 and4 modulo9 coordinates are evaluated with exact gauges. One rational matrix gives an integral relative correction exactly on the zero locus. The complete fibre over a fixed abelian class is Z3^46 x C3^9 x C9^5, with actual Smith inverse maps and the saturated relative kernel inverse. The complete relative image has16713 residues modulo9W: one zero first digit permits675 next digits; six nonzero axes in W^J permit486 each;54 other first digits permit243 each. All other residues are excluded. For A=3a the condition is (C+(p6+p8)D)a=0 overF3; the three dimension5 kernels have common dimension3 intersection, giving675 residues. The maximal all-horizontal relative lattice is9W+3W^J. Every fixed-relative nonempty fibre is Z3^52 x C3^(9+t) x C9^5, t=3 for the zero or six special first digits and0 otherwise. All forward/inverse coordinates and finite carries are retained. A0+B0 is excluded by the sum of obstruction rows3+4, identically1 modulo3 with all horizontal coefficients zero; E92 supplies actual global abelian preimages, hence a global intrinsic class-two nonlifting family. The result evaluates the local wild class-two condition on the entire global abelian localization image. The actual global good-place relations and higher intrinsic obstructions remain in E23. Root read the complete frozen theorem/proof and all three final programs; fresh copied execution reproduced all three complete JSON and stdout files byte for byte, with no exclusions. Every dependency hash remained unchanged.
